Operations.Name: GetAlbumArtists
Operations.Description: Gets all album artists from a given item, folder, or the entire library.

Options.Name: minCommunityRating
Options.Description: Optional filter by minimum community rating.

Options.Name: startIndex
Options.Description: Optional. The record index to start at. All items with a lower index will be dropped from the results.

Options.Name: limit
Options.Description: Optional. The maximum number of records to return.

Options.Name: searchTerm
Options.Description: Optional. Search term.

Options.Name: parentId
Options.Description: Specify this to localize the search to a specific item or folder. Omit to use the root.

Options.Name: fields
Options.Description: Optional. Specify additional fields of information to return in the output.

Options.Name: excludeItemTypes
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered out based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: includeItemTypes
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on item type. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: filters
Options.Description: Optional. Specify additional filters to apply.

Options.Name: isFavorite
Options.Description: Optional filter by items that are marked as favorite, or not.

Options.Name: mediaTypes
Options.Description: Optional filter by MediaType. Allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: genres
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: genreIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on genre id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: officialRatings
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on OfficialRating. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: tags
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on tag. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: years
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on production year. This allows multiple, comma delimited.

Options.Name: enableUserData
Options.Description: Optional, include user data.

Options.Name: imageTypeLimit
Options.Description: Optional, the max number of images to return, per image type.

Options.Name: enableImageTypes
Options.Description: Optional. The image types to include in the output.

Options.Name: person
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person.

Options.Name: personIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person ids.

Options.Name: personTypes
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, along with Person, results will be filtered to include only those containing the specified person and PersonType. Allows multiple, comma-delimited.

Options.Name: studios
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: studioIds
Options.Description: Optional. If specified, results will be filtered based on studio id. This allows multiple, pipe delimited.

Options.Name: userId
Options.Description: User id.

Options.Name: nameStartsWithOrGreater
Options.Description: Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally or greater than a given input string.

Options.Name: nameStartsWith
Options.Description: Optional filter by items whose name is sorted equally than a given input string.

Options.Name: nameLessThan
Options.Description: Optional filter by items whose name is equally or lesser than a given input string.

Options.Name: sortBy
Options.Description: Optional. Specify one or more sort orders, comma delimited.

Options.Name: sortOrder
Options.Description: Sort Order - Ascending,Descending.

Options.Name: enableImages
Options.Description: Optional, include image information in output.

Options.Name: enableTotalRecordCount
Options.Description: Total record count.

Options.Name: userId
Options.Description: Optional. Filter by user id, and attach user data.
